svg.text: FLASHVIEWDAMAGE (0EF3:06E7): ELEVEN PASSES OVER SIXTEEN 16 X 16 CELLS OF THE VIEW
The view, 176 x 120. Each cell is 16 x 16 pixels (2
columns by 16 lines) at an (x, y) from two byte
frame shown by cell (columns) in each pass (rows)
At the start the view on screen is copied to page 2 and the 16 cells are saved
from page 0. Each pass: restore the cells on page 2, draw those whose 2-bit code
is not 0 with shape gFlashFrames[code - 1] on page 2, copy the view to the screen,
wait 2 ticks. At the end the cells are restored on the screen.
The codes are one 32-bit word a pass (ds:564B), 2 bits a cell: the three explosion
frames sweep from cell 0 to cell 15 and die out. Pass 10 draws nothing; a last
restore leaves the view as it was.
